description: llms.txt checker — Fetches a site's /llms.txt (the llmstxt.org standard that tells AI agents which pages to read) and validates it: required H1 title, summary blockquote, H2 sections with '- [name](url): notes' link lists, malformed lines, relative/duplicate links, size, content-type (catches SPA HTML fallbacks), Optional section, and /llms-full.txt presence. Samples up to 5 links for reachability (check_links=0 to skip). Returns VALID / VALID WITH WARNINGS / INVALID / MISSING, a 0-100 score, sections with sample links, and fixes. url= accepts a domain or a full llms.txt URL. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_llms_txt_check
